english.title: Ride a pedal cycle etc in dangerous manner in a Royal Park - Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Reg's 97

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Regulations 1997

english.standardoffencewording:

(C)_[an open space]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation3(10) of the Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Regulations 1997 and section2 of the Parks Regulation (Amendment) Act 1926.
